numerical_failure.observed_behavior: `UECMResults.resid` returns residuals computed against the levels series `model.endog` (i.e., `model.endog - fittedvalues`) instead of residuals computed against the differenced series `model._y` used in the UECM equation.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: `UECMResults.resid` should compute residuals against the differenced dependent variable: `model._y - fittedvalues` (i.e., `model._y - self.fittedvalues`).
trigger_conditions: Using `UECMResults.resid` for a UECM model where the UECM dependent variable is ΔY (first difference of endog) stored in `model._y`.
A code path where `UECMResults` inherits `resid` from its parent class so the residuals are computed as levels-based `endog - fittedvalues` rather than differenced `model._y - fittedvalues`.
Downstream diagnostics (Durbin-Watson, Breusch-Godfrey, etc.) computed from the incorrect residuals become completely incorrect because the residuals are “close to the level values of the series.”
oracle_clues: UECM dependent variable is ΔY (first difference of endog), stored in `model._y`.
Incorrect behavior: `UECMResults` inherited `resid` from the parent class which computes `endog - fittedvalues` (levels minus fitted differences).
Correct behavior: override `UECMResults.resid` to compute `model._y - fittedvalues`.
Incorrect residuals are described as “close to the level values of the series,” which makes downstream diagnostics (Durbin-Watson, Breusch-Godfrey, etc.) completely incorrect.
The fix is described as: “Override the `resid` property in `UECMResults` to correctly compute `model._y - fittedvalues`.”
A proposed test assertion (for correctness) is: `np.testing.assert_allclose(res.resid, res.model._y - res.fittedvalues)` (no numeric constants provided in the passages).

category_specific_evidence: UECM dependent variable is the first difference ΔY of endog, stored in model._y.
UECMResults.resid previously computed residuals as levels minus fitted differences (endog - fittedvalues), i.e. model.endog - fittedvalues, instead of differenced residuals computed against model._y.

Issue description: UECMResults.resid incorrectly returns residuals computed against the levels series (model.endog) instead of the differenced series (model._y), which is the actual dependent variable in the UECM equation.

Fix/test assertion: np.testing.assert_allclose(res.resid, res.model._y - res.fittedvalues). This demonstrates the required mathematical property for correctness: resid must equal model._y − fittedvalues (not model.endog − fittedvalues).
reproduction_risks: Risk of not reproducing if resid override is already backported/available in the environment under test.
Without using UECM (so that the dependent variable in the equation is stored in model._y as a differenced series), the residual computation target may not be model._y − fittedvalues.
